title: A new Evia update is ready
details: Bricklayer ST0095 v1.2 now requires its installed Nisi course pack in learner and Admin course selectors
Existing Bricklayer learners keep the verified migration and all existing evidence, RPL, OTJ, EPA and target data
The legacy Bricklayer definition remains only as a fail-safe migration rollback while the other current courses are converted to packs
